listing.name: Ratchet & Clank — OpenRAC (OpenRAC)
listing.summary: The launcher release includes the first native port and skips unmatched assembly. SDK releases and matching-progress counts do not establish that all six games are playable. See below for original-file requirements and setup. Portcove has not confirmed setup or gameplay.

steps.title: Check the required game files
steps.instruction: Use your own PAL SCES-50916 Ratchet & Clank ISO for the first native player target. The other documented decompilation targets are distinct: RAC1 NTSC SCUS97199, RAC2 SCUS97268, RAC3 SCUS97353, Deadlocked SCUS97465, Size Matters SCUS97615 and Secret Agent SCUS97623. They are not established player ports.

steps.title: Follow upstream setup
steps.instruction: Download OpenRAC launcher; carries native RAC1 PAL runtime and preparation tools; select own ISO folder. Other game rows are matching-decomp research, not player targets.

warnings: The launcher release includes the first native port and skips unmatched assembly. SDK releases and matching-progress counts do not establish that all six games are playable.
Portcove has not confirmed setup, gameplay, saves or updates for this experimental port.
